name: Penicillin G benzathine
executiveSummary: Depot penicillin **IM only**. Adult: early syphilis 2.4 MU IM once; late 2.4 MU weekly × 3. Rheumatic fever prophylaxis 1.2 MU every 3–4 weeks. Pediatrics by weight (syphilis 50,000 IU/kg; RF by kg).
indications:
## Indications

- Syphilis (stage-based regimens).
- Secondary prophylaxis of rheumatic fever / recurrent streptococcal infection.
- Selected streptococcal pharyngitis when single-dose IM is chosen.

## Route precautions

- **NEVER IV** (risk of ischemia/embolism/fatal outcome).
- **Deep IM only** (upper outer quadrant of buttock or vastus lateralis in children).
- Caution under 2 years; penicillin allergy.

> Do not interchange with IV sodium penicillin G or procaine penicillin without reviewing the regimen.

adulto.dose: Early syphilis (primary/secondary/early latent): **2.4 MU IM once**. Late latent / unknown duration: **2.4 MU IM once weekly × 3 weeks**. Rheumatic fever prophylaxis: **1.2 MU IM every 3–4 weeks**. Streptococcal pharyngitis (alternative): **1.2 MU IM once**.
adulto.administration: Deep IM only. Reconstitute with sterile water (e.g. 1.2 MU in 5 mL; 2.4 MU in 10 mL); shake to a homogeneous suspension. No IV or SC.
adulto.notes: Use immediately after reconstitution; discard remainder.

pediatrico.dose: Syphilis: **50,000 IU/kg/dose IM** (1–3 doses by stage/duration; max **2.4 MU/dose**). Rheumatic fever prophylaxis: **≤ 27 kg: 600,000 IU** every 3–4 weeks; **> 27 kg: 1.2 MU** every 3–4 weeks.
pediatrico.administration: Deep IM. Careful technique in infants.
pediatrico.notes: Typical administration weekly or every 3–4 weeks by indication — not a daily regimen.

neonatal.dose: Congenital syphilis: most scenarios use **IV penicillin G sodium**, not benzathine. Benzathine only if the syphilis protocol explicitly indicates it (selected cases without neurosyphilis).
neonatal.administration: IM only if the regimen orders it.
neonatal.notes: Always confirm with ID / congenital syphilis guidance.

stability:
## Stability

- Reconstituted: immediate use; do not store.
- Do not dilute for IV use.
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Local pain, allergic rashes, fever. Rare: hemolytic anemia, leukopenia, anaphylaxis. Embolism/ischemia if given IV by error.
